name: TileAboveTheFoldContent

props.name: clicked
props.description: Boolean for whether a tile has been clicked.

props.name: decorator
props.description: **Experimental**: Provide a `decorator` component or set the boolean to True for an AILabel icon to be rendered inside the `ClickableTile` component

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the ClickableTile should be disabled

props.name: hasRoundedCorners
props.description: **Experimental**: Specify if the `ClickableTile` component should be rendered with rounded corners. Only valid when `slug` prop is present

props.name: rel
props.description: Specify the function to run when the ClickableTile is clicked / onClick?(event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement> | KeyboardEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>): void; /** Specify the function to run when the ClickableTile is interacted with via a keyboard / onKeyDown?(event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>): void; /** The rel property for the link.

props.name: renderIcon
props.description: A component used to render an icon.

props.name: slug
props.description: **Experimental**: Specify if a `Slug` icon should be rendered inside the `ClickableTile`

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TileAboveTheFoldContent rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
